title: Business Silver Rewards Card: Understanding Your Included Travel Insurance Coverage
summary: Explains the Business Silver Rewards Card’s included travel insurance for eligible trips purchased with the card, including coverage for covered trip interruptions/cancellations/delays and baggage issues up to $15,000 per trip. Describes the $15,000 maximum payable per trip (subject to policy terms/exclusions), required proof of card payment, and supporting documentation, plus guidance to keep receipts/confirmations and report incidents promptly.
faqs: What is the maximum travel insurance coverage amount per trip for the Business Silver Rewards Card?
Which types of events (trip interruptions, cancellations, delays, baggage issues) can be covered on eligible card-purchased trips?
Do the travel insurance benefits apply as secondary or primary coverage?
What documentation do I need to file a travel insurance claim (proof of payment and supporting materials)?
What should I do before filing a claim (e.g., how to organize receipts/confirmations and delay/cancellation correspondence)?
How soon should I report an incident, and where do I find the claim instructions?
